posts.subject: Re:monitor settings
posts.author: DFWTechGuy
posts.message_html:
When I checked the Legion R24s user guide, and I don't see a separate Deep Sleep option listed in its OSD menu. The available sections are Game Settings, Screen Settings, Color Settings, Port Settings, and OSD Settings.

It may not be a feature available on the R24s, depending on the exact regional/model variant. You can check the monitor's OSD by pressing the joystick/button in the center, then reviewing the Port or OSD settings.

If you’re looking for a power-saving or standby setting, what are you trying to achieve exactly? Also, can you confirm the full model code shown on the monitor label?
